## Automated Sales Report Generator
Every Monday at 8am: last week's numbers, what changed, and why, written for the MD.

Every Monday at 8am it reads transactions (date, order_id, branch, product, qty, unit_price), compares the latest 7 days with the 7 before, finds the biggest movers and top branch, and emails the MD a plain-English report.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/sales-report-generator
